objective: One short two-input C/Java probability diagnostic; no generation or judges.
comparison: Compare plan04 fixed coding on the same A100/RTX pair: alternate the first two problems in the original seeded batch1 order rather than repeating just the first. Identical AB750 initialization, fresh AdamW/seed42, original coding prompt, SDPA/native BF16 head, batch1, constant1e-5,100 total updates and evaluation every10. Each training problem receives50 updates, versus100 on one problem in the fixed baseline; this is matched total updates, not matched exposures per problem. Select by mean full-vocabulary target loss on the two training inputs, measure each input separately, and retain original heldout10 to distinguish fitting from generalization.

trials.optimizer: Fresh AdamW with original betas/epsilon/weight_decay; deliberately no old optimizer transfer.
trials.name: AB-init-two-fixed-coding
